mapper.select:
select t.T_Name as tName, pro.P_Name as pName, sec.Sec_Name as secName, con.Con_Name as conName, c.C_Name as cName,
from ${tableCode} f left join SYS_FileTemplate t on t.T_ID=f.T_ID left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_ID=f.FileProject left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id=f.FileSectionID left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=f.FileContract left join Sys_Company c on c.C_ID=f.FileCreateCompanyID left join SYS_User u on u.U_ID=f.FileCreateUser where FileID=#{fileId}
mapper.sql: f.FileID as fileid, f.T_ID as tId, f.FileTitle as filetitle, f.FileCode as filecode, f.FileKeyWord as filekeyword, f.FileEmergencyLevel as fileemergencylevel, f.FileDescription as filedescription, f.FileFlowStatus as fileflowstatus, f.FileCreateDate as filecreatedate, f.FileCreateUser as filecreateUser, f.FileCreateUserName as filecreateusername, f.FileCreateCompanyID as filecreatecompanyid, f.FileProject as fileproject, f.FileSectionID as filesectionid, f.FileContract as filecontract, f.T_Code as tCode, f.Flow_Id as flowId
mapper.select: select max(FileCreateDate) as maxDoTime,min(FileCreateDate) as minDoTime from ${tableCode} where T_Code not like '%_Flow' and T_Code not like '%_flow' and Te_Id = #{teId}
